summary: Golden Sun Technology Group filed a Form 6-K, the foreign private issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K current report, disclosing that effective September 21, 2026, its board appointed Ms. Bekazela Matshazi as Co-Chief Executive Officer, serving alongside incumbent CEO Xueyuan Weng, who remains in place and signed the report. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The appointment is an addition rather than a departure, so no forced or abrupt exit is evident. Watch for disclosure of any related leadership restructuring or strategy shift.
